summary: Perth, Australia, software engineer with 15 years of experience, strong opinions on cybersecurity and data privacy, critical of Linode's security practices, advocates for transparency in tech companies, interested in web development technologies (Ruby, C, Java, Go), engaged in discussions about tech industry ethics and gender equality, skeptical of corporate practices regarding taxes and social responsibility, supports multilateral engagement in foreign policy, critical of Google and Apple’s business practices, has a nuanced view on political issues, particularly regarding regulation and corporate responsibility.
